title: A family of tetranuclear quinolinolate Dy(III)-based single-molecule magnets: effects of periphery ligand replacement on their magnetic relaxation

material_class.structural_family: planar tetranuclear Dy4 cluster with 8-quinolinolate and peripheral β-diketonate ligands

synthesis.procedure: Dyq3·H2O (0.047 g, 0.075 mmol) and equimolar Dy(acac)3·H2O (0.036 g, 0.075 mmol) were added to dichloromethane (30 mL) and stirred for 3 hours, giving a clear solution. After filtration, the concentrated dichloromethane solution was layered with n-hexane to afford yellow crystals after one week.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction followed by filtration and layering crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtration; concentrated CH2Cl2 solution layered with n-hexane; yellow crystals after one week

properties.summary: Zero-field Dy4 SMM. χMT = 58.02 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K (1000 Oe), decreasing to 31.06 cm3 K mol−1 at 1.8 K. Magnetization at 2 K reaches 22.35 Nβ without saturation at 7 T. Frequency-dependent χ″ peaks near 10 K indicate slow relaxation with QTM below ~7 K. Raman+Orbach fits give Ueff/kB = 50 K, τ0 = 2.7×10−6 s at zero field and Ueff/kB = 64 K, τ0 = 9.6×10−7 s at 600 Oe; high-T Arrhenius linear region Ueff/kB = 52 K at zero field. Cole–Cole α = 0.03–0.3 (5–11.5 K).

properties.summary: Zero-field Dy4 SMM. χMT = 56.41 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K, 35.95 cm3 K mol−1 at 1.8 K. properties.summary: Field-induced rather than zero-field SMM despite a similar Dy4 core. χMT = 57.17 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K and 35.32 cm3 K mol−1 at 1.8 K. Magnetization 24.51 Nβ without saturation at 7 T. Only rising frequency-dependent χ″ vs T at zero field; no full χ″ vs ν peaks even under 1500 Oe, so Ueff could not be extracted. QTM is more pronounced than in 1 and 2.
